picker.menuLabel: Row that opens the symbol picker from the toolbar overflow menu
picker.all: Tab showing every symbol from every category
picker.insert: Accessible name of a symbol button; {{latex}} is the macro and stays verbatim
picker.tooltip: Tooltip over a symbol button; {{latex}} is the macro and stays verbatim

categories.misc: Symbols that fit no other category

greekLower.epsilon: The \epsilon glyph; keep distinct from varepsilon
greekLower.varepsilon: The \varepsilon glyph; keep distinct from epsilon
greekLower.phi: The \phi glyph; keep distinct from varphi
greekLower.varphi: The \varphi glyph; keep distinct from phi

operators.star: The \star glyph, a five-pointed operator; keep distinct from asterisk
operators.asterisk: The \ast glyph; keep distinct from star
operators.circle: The \circ composition operator, not a filled dot
operators.partialDerivative: The \partial symbol used for partial derivatives

calculus.nablaGradient: The same \nabla glyph, listed here as the gradient operator
calculus.partial: The same \partial glyph, listed here among calculus operators

logic.logicalAnd: The \land connective; keep distinct from wedge
logic.wedge: The \wedge glyph, the same shape used outside logic
logic.logicalOr: The \lor connective; keep distinct from vee
logic.vee: The \vee glyph, the same shape used outside logic

sets.emptySetVariant: The \varnothing glyph, a variant of the empty set

spacing.quadSpace: A horizontal space one quad wide
spacing.romanUprightMath: Upright roman letters inside math mode

misc.diamondSuit: The diamond suit glyph; keep distinct from the diamond operator

accents.dotDerivative: A single dot accent, commonly a time derivative
accents.checkCaron: The \check accent, also called a caron
